values.ink.lab.intro: Write with Apple Pencil, a stylus, a finger or a mouse. The lab measures input-to-paint latency, shows which input features this browser offers, and stress-tests scrolling on a page with {count} strokes.

values.ink.lab.protocol_1: Turn on Slow-motion mode: thick black ink on paper and a frame counter above the page.
values.ink.lab.protocol_2: Record the iPad screen with another phone at 240 fps, close up, Pencil tip and ink both in frame.
values.ink.lab.protocol_3: Draw fast, short strokes. In the video, count frames from the tip touching to the first ink pixel.
values.ink.lab.protocol_4: Each frame is 4.17 ms; the target is 20 ms or less (about 5 frames). Note the median of 10 strokes.
values.ink.lab.protocol_5: Repeat with Predicted ink off. Record both in docs/PROGRESS.md with the iPad and iPadOS version.
values.ink.lab.sample_intro: Write anywhere on this page. On plain text the marker sits under the words; on a page with a table, a figure or a PDF it blends over them.
